safety: motor IDs assigned and encoders calibrated
battery: emergency stop pressed and power off
no metal tools on connector while powered
power_on: all motors absolute-zero calibrated before Reset
inference: feet fully on ground, CoM even
joysticks swept full range, LT/RT pressed
supervisor holds hanger rope, ready to press X

estop.fire: stop, isolate, report; dry powder extinguisher, never water; evacuate >3 m

rules: Joint work only with e-stop pressed and power disconnected
Never put fingers in joint gaps or limit slots
Chemical wipes go in yellow hazardous waste
Reset only after zero calibration, pose matched by hand
Simulate any modified code before hardware
